beats.text: James Cameron just dropped a 198-minute Avatar sequel with a new villain Na'vi tribe that worships fire.

beats.label: setup
beats.text: Avatar: Fire and Ash picks up after the RDA war and the loss of the Sully family's eldest son. A new Na'vi faction emerges: the Ash People, a power-hungry tribe led by the ruthless Varang. They worship destruction and threaten Pandora itself.

beats.label: standout
beats.text: This is the longest Avatar film yet at 3 hours 18 minutes, and James Cameron's most ambitious VFX project since Avatar: The Way of Water won 4 Oscars. The Ash People design and the fire-themed environments push the visual ceiling further.

beats.label: cta
beats.text: Avatar: Fire and Ash is in theaters now and streaming. The world of Pandora will change forever.

spoken_text: James Cameron just dropped a 198-minute Avatar sequel with a new villain Na'vi tribe that worships fire. Avatar: Fire and Ash picks up after the RDA war and the loss of the Sully family's eldest son. A new Na'vi faction emerges: the Ash People, a power-hungry tribe led by the ruthless Varang. They worship destruction and threaten Pandora itself. This is the longest Avatar film yet at 3 hours 18 minutes, and James Cameron's most ambitious VFX project since Avatar: The Way of Water won 4 Oscars. The Ash People design and the fire-themed environments push the visual ceiling further. Avatar: Fire and Ash is in theaters now and streaming. The world of Pandora will change forever.
